title: The actual scalar tensor diagram of whole complexes
statement: A chain diagram is a record of four objects, three composable arrows and a second arrow between their endpoints. For finite R, p:X→Y and P,Q, construct this record in the category of intrinsic module cochain complexes, with the four native total complexes as vertices, the three specified left chain maps as edges and the specified right chain path as the other arrow. It contains no compatibility or proof fields.

proof.text: Construct the four actual cochain complexes before degree evaluation. Fill the three left arrows from the specified tuple and the right arrow from its specified composite. The types identify the same native tensor-total objects at their common endpoints.

def finiteScalarTensorNativeChainDiagram
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) :
    FiniteScalarTensorChainDiagram
      (CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)) ℤ)
